title: Email to Nolan about a glowing object that drops molten metal

tellings.quote: Actually, there's one that I just got in the last few weeks an email from somebody who uh it's a a glowing object that drops molten metal.

plain: Garry Nolan, a Stanford University scientist who studies material said to come from UFOs, told podcaster Jesse Michels in 2021 that he had just received an email from someone describing a glowing object that dropped molten metal. Nolan mentions it as one more of the reports people send him, which matter to him because leftover metal could, in principle, be tested in a lab.
